description: Implementation of NotificationReadPlatformService for handling notification data retrieval, cache management, and read status updates in the Fineract platform.

classes.name: NotificationMapperRow

classes.name: NotificationDataRow
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result set to NotificationData objects.

methods.name: hasUnreadNotifications
methods.description: Checks if the user has any unread notifications, utilizing cache for efficiency.

methods.description: Marks all notifications as read for the authenticated user.
